review_locator: PMCID:PMC7015949, Immunoregulatory Sensory Circuits in Group 3 Innate Lymphoid Cell Function and Tissue Homeostasis; PMCID:PMC11108440, Innate lymphoid cells in health and disease
primary_title: Interleukin-22 induces interleukin-18 expression from epithelial cells during intestinal infection
decision_basis: The reviews identify the Muñoz primary showing that IL-22 increases Il18 mRNA in intestinal epithelial cells during Toxoplasma gondii or Citrobacter rodentium infection and maintains homeostatic pro-IL-18 expression.
limitations_preserved: Gene-expression bridge only; preserve IL-22-to-Il18 transcription in mouse intestinal epithelium, distinguish active IL-18 from pro-IL-18 and do not infer processing, receptor occupancy, SCI relevance, or terminal-TF effects.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC7015949, Immunoregulatory Sensory Circuits in Group 3 Innate Lymphoid Cell Function and Tissue Homeostasis; PMCID:PMC11108440, Innate lymphoid cells in health and disease
primary_title: Interleukin-22 induces interleukin-18 expression from epithelial cells during intestinal infection
decision_basis: The cited primary reports that IL-22 augments inactive precursor pro-IL-18 protein in intestinal epithelial cells and maintains the homeostatic ileal amount, but does not induce processing to active IL-18.
limitations_preserved: Protein-output bridge only; preserve pro-IL-18 precursor semantics and the absence of demonstrated processing to active IL-18, which remains a separate CASP1-dependent step; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC7015949, Immunoregulatory Sensory Circuits in Group 3 Innate Lymphoid Cell Function and Tissue Homeostasis; PMCID:PMC5713383, Regulation of Chemokine-Receptor Interactions and Functions
primary_title: The chemokine receptor CXCR6 controls the functional topography of interleukin-22 producing intestinal innate lymphoid cells
decision_basis: The reviews identify the Satoh-Takayama primary showing that CXCL16 from CX3CR1-positive intestinal dendritic cells positions CXCR6-positive NKp46-positive ILC3s; Cxcr6 loss selectively depletes lamina-propria ILC3s and IL-22-dependent epithelial defense.
limitations_preserved: Recruitment/topography bridge; preserve CXCL16-producing DC and CXCR6-positive NKp46-positive ILC3 context, distinguish recruitment from direct cytokine activation, and do not infer SCI relevance or terminal-TF effects.
